name: Dorota
home: Cottage at the swamp’s edge, Nebruz
found: Her cottage at the swamp’s edge, brewing.
appearance: Looks late 20s. Swamp-stained hem. Charms at her throat.
and_yet: Far older than she looks. Fae blood.
wants: Village health; peace with the swamp tribes.
does_not_want: The temple reopened. War with the tribes.
oddly_also: Most charms and love potions are placebos. Her healing is real.
knows: How to reach Leeandra. Effemi’s true past — Effemi doesn’t know she knows.
